# Lumiere Education

> Lumiere Education connects high school and middle school students with PhD mentors from Harvard, Oxford, and Stanford for independent research mentorship and college preparation.

Lumiere Education is a research mentorship platform founded by Harvard and Oxford researchers that provides students with access to PhD mentors for independent research projects. The organization operates as both a for-profit program and a 501(c)(3) nonprofit foundation committed to making research opportunities accessible to low-income students.

## Programs & Admissions

- [Programs](https://www.lumiere-education.com/lumiere-programs): Overview of Lumiere research programs, deadlines, and application information.
- [Student Application](https://www.lumiere-education.com/students-application-form): Application portal for Lumiere Research Scholar and Junior Explorer programs.
- [Junior Explorer Program](https://www.lumiere-education.com/junior-explorer-program): Research mentorship program for middle school students with PhD mentors.
- [Lumiere Scholars Essay Award](https://www.lumiere-education.com/lumiere-scholars-essay-award): Global essay competition for ambitious high school students with scholarships.
- [Admissions Officer Sessions](https://www.lumiere-education.com/admission-officer-sessions): College admissions preparation sessions with officers from top universities.

## About & Mission

- [Lumiere Education](https://www.lumiere-education.com): Homepage for Lumiere Education research mentorship program connecting students with PhD mentors.
- [Who Are We?](https://www.lumiere-education.com/about): Organization mission and overview of Harvard/Oxford researchers behind Lumiere Education.
- [Welcome Letter](https://www.lumiere-education.com/letter-from-founder): Founder's introduction to Lumiere Research Scholar Program and organizational mission.
- [Our Academic Principles](https://www.lumiere-education.com/our-academic-principles): Core academic expectations and principles for Lumiere's research community.
- [Lumiere Research Inclusion Foundation](https://www.lumiere-education.com/our-social-commitment): 501(c)(3) nonprofit providing free research opportunities to low-income students.
